exact_return_preservation.necessary_and_sufficient_word_equality: Q=c if and only if, for every j with r_j in W, c_j=0.
exact_return_preservation.proof: The CALL is the last pre-AND write to every return-slot byte and stores c. The AND can only replace overlapping bytes with zero. Uniqueness of the four-byte little-endian representation makes equality equivalent to every replaced c byte already being zero.
exact_return_preservation.disjoint_case: R disjoint W is sufficient, not necessary.
exact_return_preservation.full_overlap_case: If all return bytes are in W then Q=0; preservation holds exactly when c=0 under the model. Offset zero does not itself prove a legal return or linear address zero.
exact_return_preservation.partial_overlap_case: Only overlapping return bytes are zeroed. Overlap can preserve the offset when all affected bytes were already zero.
exact_return_preservation.scope_of_iff: Exact four-byte return-offset equality under the stated memory model, not a sufficient condition for successful RET, intact fetched code or real runtime continuation.
exact_return_preservation.diversion: If normal RET produces Q other than c, it does not establish the stipulated 00BF670C continuation; no subsequent POP/direct-tail effects are claimed for that branch.
